lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2016 in Chad. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) for February, June, and October 2016, representing the food security situation at those time periods.
